dimensions.question: How clearly can a prospective Tomorrowland Belgium visitor understand the difference among festival passes, DreamVille accommodation, premium access, Global Journey travel, cashless payment and zone-specific rights before committing?
dimensions.scopeChange: Discovery is treated as a package-and-entitlement problem rather than ticket discovery alone.

observations.text: The public offer contains materially different products including festival passes, DreamVille packages, premium access and Global Journey packages.
Festival access does not automatically include DreamVille access.
DreamVille package type can determine access to restricted internal zones.
Pre-registration does not guarantee successful purchase.

unanswered: Representative buyer comprehension is not established.
Sale-success probability and conversion by package are not public.
Mobile-versus-desktop discovery quality has not been tested.
dimensions.reason: The public product structure is well exposed, but comprehension, availability dynamics and buyer outcomes remain unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Compare representative purchase paths and test how ticket, DreamVille, premium and Global Journey rights are communicated at decision time.

dimensions.question: What becomes committed when a visitor purchases a Tomorrowland Pass or Package, and which rights remain conditional on payment, personalization, identity, Bracelet state, package type, provider or programme conditions?
dimensions.scopeChange: Reservation is decomposed into order, Main Buyer role, individual personalization and downstream service entitlements.

observations.text: Selected inventory is not secured until payment is completed.
A paid order still requires individual personalization and identity-linked entitlement.
The Main Buyer and individual visitors can be different roles.
DreamVille and Global Journey packages create commitments beyond simple festival admission.

unanswered: Internal reservation identifiers across package components are unknown.
Oversell and payment-failure recovery are not public.
Cross-provider modification propagation is unverified.
dimensions.reason: The reservation sequence and role separation are explicit, but system coupling and failure handling remain incomplete.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Inspect confirmation, modification and cancellation behavior across ticket, accommodation and transport components.

dimensions.question: What must a visitor resolve before arrival, including personalization, Bracelet delivery/activation, travel-provider rules, cashless setup, identity, accessibility and schedule information?
dimensions.scopeChange: Pre-arrival includes credential fulfilment, Global Journey preparation and cashless state because these materially affect later service use.

observations.text: Personalization and identity matching are required before the visitor can safely rely on access entitlement.
Bracelet delivery can fail without eliminating the underlying entitlement because on-site pickup exists.
Cashless top-up behavior before arrival can alter the later refund workflow.
Global Journey travel rules remain transport-mode/provider specific after purchase.

unanswered: Bracelet delivery and activation failure rates are unknown.
Carrier-change recovery is not operationally verified.
Accessibility fulfilment quality is not established.
dimensions.reason: Pre-arrival dependencies are clearly declared, but live recovery and cross-provider information continuity are not verified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek operational evidence on Bracelet failure, carrier change, accessibility preparation and arrival-day recovery.

dimensions.question: At what point does a visitor become operationally admitted to the festival or DreamVille, and how do identity, Bracelet, time, package, zone, re-entry and accessibility affect admission?
dimensions.scopeChange: Arrival is treated as multiple access-validation events rather than one gate crossing.

observations.text: Festival admission remains subject to stated check-in cutoffs even where the visitor holds valid entry rights.
Festival and DreamVille have distinct arrival windows and access rights.
A missing Bracelet can be replaced at arrival using e-ticket and photo ID.
DreamVille zone access remains package-specific after admission.

unanswered: Queue and ID-check performance are unknown.
Denied-entry and zone-dispute recovery are not public.
Live capacity state at entry is not established.
dimensions.reason: The access states are explicit, but admission performance and recovery quality remain unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek entrance-performance, denied-entry, Bracelet-failure and accessibility-arrival evidence.

dimensions.question: How does participation operate after admission when festival access, DreamVille accommodation, zones, stages, premium areas, cashless payment, health support and temporary services each have different rules or capacities?
dimensions.scopeChange: Stay is treated as participation across event and accommodation service states rather than occupancy alone.

observations.text: DreamVille functions as a temporary living environment with shared and area-specific services.
Area-specific sanitary, dining and support services differ within DreamVille.
Festival admission does not guarantee premium-area access.
Programme/stage state can change while overall admission remains valid.

unanswered: Live stage and facility capacity are unknown.
Service utilisation and wait times are not public.
Medical and support outcomes are not verified.
dimensions.reason: Multiple service states are well documented, but live capacity, utilisation and recovery remain unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek capacity, wait-time, service-recovery and medical-support performance evidence.

dimensions.question: How does food and beverage operate across Tomorrowland and DreamVille when visitors can self-provision, buy from shared or area-specific outlets, purchase add-on meals and pay through cashless Bracelets?
dimensions.scopeChange: Dining separates food availability, accommodation-zone eligibility and cashless-payment state.

observations.text: DreamVille permits self-provisioning while also offering commercial food and beverage services.
Some dining is area-specific and can inherit accommodation-zone restrictions.
Breakfast can be a separately purchased add-on rather than part of accommodation entitlement.
Bracelet access state and Pearl balance/refund state are separate.

unanswered: Allergen and dietary-safety handling are incomplete.
Live queues and outlet capacity are unknown.
Payment-outage and vendor-level recovery are not public.
dimensions.reason: The dining/payment architecture is visible, but operational reliability, dietary safety and economics are unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek representative allergen guidance, cashless-outage handling, queue data and vendor responsibility evidence.

dimensions.question: What ends when a visitor leaves the festival or DreamVille, and which transport, cashless, refund, lost-property, account or identity relationships remain open afterward?
dimensions.scopeChange: Departure includes physical checkout, return transport, refunds, lost property and digital/account persistence.

observations.text: DreamVille has a final mandatory checkout while Global Journey return transport can continue afterward.
Cashless refunds can remain active after physical departure and use different automatic/manual workflows.
Lost-property claims can continue after the visitor has left.
Cashless balances are time-scoped by event/weekend rather than one continuous relationship.

unanswered: Refund success rates are unknown.
Missed-return transport recovery is not public.
Post-event complaint ownership is incomplete.
dimensions.reason: Physical departure is clearly separate from financial, property and travel closure, but outcome performance remains unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek refund outcomes, lost-property recovery rates, return-transport recovery and post-event support evidence.

dimensions.question: How is atmosphere created when the institution is temporary, themed, divided across stages and DreamVille spaces, and dependent on crowd, music, light, weather, time and access rights?
dimensions.scopeChange: Atmosphere is treated as an engineered, time-dependent service state rather than decoration alone.

observations.text: The Gathering creates an entitled pre-festival atmosphere for DreamVille visitors.
The 2026 Consciencia theme was translated from narrative into physical MainStage architecture.
DreamVille functions as a distinct living/recovery atmosphere from the main festival.
Weather and programme conditions can change the available atmospheric experience.

unanswered: Representative emotional response is not established.
Crowd-density comfort and sensory accessibility are unknown.
Atmosphere during failure or disruption is not independently verified.
dimensions.reason: Atmosphere design and narrative intent are strong, but lived outcome and operational resilience remain unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Compare official claims with independent visitor evidence and adverse-weather/disruption experience.

dimensions.question: What does current Tomorrowland photography reveal about the temporary hospitality ecosystem, and where does curated imagery stop short of proving access, capacity, safety, service quality or recovery?
dimensions.scopeChange: Photography is used to establish current visual presentation across festival, DreamVille, food and Global Journey, not live operating performance.

observations.text: Official 2026 media galleries cover festival, DreamVille, food and Global Journey categories.
Current festival and DreamVille galleries provide substantial visual evidence for the 2026 edition.
The MainStage production story supports that the photographed 2026 environment was physically built.

unanswered: Official imagery is not a representative operating sample.
Queues, denied entry, sanitation, accessibility and recovery states are underrepresented.
No independent image comparison has been completed.
dimensions.reason: Current visual coverage is strong for presentation but weak for access, failure and operational performance.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Compare official imagery with independent visitor imagery focused on arrival, queues, sanitation, accessibility and recovery.

dimensions.question: How does Tomorrowland construct one coherent institutional story across ticketing, travel, DreamVille, festival admission, temporary architecture, media and post-event memory, and how much of that continuity reflects operational integration?
dimensions.scopeChange: Story includes pre-event narrative, temporary physical institution, travel/accommodation, post-event media and persistent digital/financial relationships.

observations.text: Tomorrowland has maintained institutional continuity across repeated temporary events since 2005.
The 2026 Consciencia narrative began before the event and was embedded physically in the MainStage.
DreamVille extends the story from event attendance into temporary living.
Media and narrative continue after the physical event closes.

unanswered: Visitor narrative comprehension is not established.
Internal integration behind the seamless story is unknown.
Theme-driven commercial effect is unverified.
dimensions.reason: Institutional continuity and narrative translation are well documented, but operational integration and commercial effect remain incomplete.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek independent visitor perception and cross-provider operating evidence before assigning stronger institutional conclusions.
